description: BOOK a new appointment. MUTATES DATA — creates an appointment in the connected EHR/PMS (optionally notifying the patient). Provide either end_time or appointment_type_id. POST /appointments.

appointment_type_id.description: Appointment type id (determines duration if end_time omitted).

end_time.description: Appointment end, ISO8601 datetime (or set appointment_type_id).

notify_patient.description: Notify the patient (sent as notify_patient query param).

subdomain.description: Institution subdomain. Defaults to NEXHEALTH_SUBDOMAIN if unset.

name: nexhealth_book_appointment
title: Book appointment
